explication: PM Skills Marketplace is a collection of nine installable product-management plugins for AI assistants. A user invokes a command or asks for a task; the assistant follows the relevant workflow, drawing on skills that provide frameworks and domain guidance, and produces a PM artifact or analysis. The plugins span discovery, strategy, research, analytics, execution, go-to-market, growth, toolkit tasks, and shipping AI-built code. The README describes the marketplace model and selected workflow chains; the graph groups capabilities by plugin, without implying undocumented command-to-skill links.
